purpose: Recover the lost interactive matrix control plane without interrupting, duplicating, relabeling, or changing the scientific configuration of the two adopted in-flight AdamW runs.

incident.symptom: The torchrun TCPStore and interactive matrix controller disappeared. All eight training ranks became children of PID 1 and repeatedly emitted ProcessGroupNCCL heartbeat Broken-pipe warnings while continuing to advance and write checkpoints.
incident.observed_training_state_at_freeze: 0/12 runs complete; both adopted AdamW runs were beyond step 3190 with checkpoints 782, 1563, 2345, and 3126 deeply resumable.
incident.interpretation: The repeated TCPStore heartbeat lines are one control-plane incident affecting two runs, not tens of thousands of independent NCCL data-plane failures. The run outputs remain incomplete until the normal deep completion gate passes.

recovery_contract.existing_workers: Do not signal or restart the adopted ranks. Wait until every explicitly recorded top-level training PID exits.
recovery_contract.handoff_gate: Only after all adopted PIDs exit, invoke the unchanged matrix runner. Its deep completion gate skips a fully complete run; otherwise it resumes only from the latest deeply valid scheduled checkpoint.
recovery_contract.configuration: Use the frozen matrix, Dense-only scope, GPU pools 0,1,2,3 and 4,5,6,7, ports 29610 and 29620, the existing dense-no-packing log root, and the formal system Python.
recovery_contract.durability: Run the supervisor in a detached session, publish an atomic JSON state file, and restart a failed matrix controller until all 12 selected runs pass deep completion.
recovery_contract.observability: The progress report separates fatal CUDA/NCCL/non-finite/traceback markers from repeated TCPStore control-plane heartbeat warnings. Warning totals count log lines and affected runs, not independent incidents.
recovery_contract.external_process_boundary: Do not inspect, read, edit, signal, stop, replace, or otherwise touch gpu.py or its processes.

completion_rule: Recovery is complete only when the source-bound supervisor reports all 12 matrix runs deeply complete. Training results retain the original one-seed corrected-replication claim boundary; this operational incident neither strengthens nor weakens a scientific result by itself.
